children: Live cattle futures on the CME close up 0.3% to $2.2335 a pound, as the push/pull between producers and packers continues. "The positive basis keeps futures tethered, but more like with a rubber band than a string," says Chris Swift of Swift Trading Co. "I anticipate more stagnation of price than direction as consumers are continually having to adjust to the rampant inflation making the relationship between cattle and beef complicated." Lean hog futures settle 0.8% lower at 68.85 cents a pound. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
